# iOS makes an event: PUT with If-None-Match: * into the (virtual)
# default calendar, which becomes real; 201 with the ETag of the bytes. The
# same PUT again is 412; the same bytes without condition 204, same ETag.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 201
< header ETag {etag:dentist.ics}

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: dentist-moved.ics
< status 412

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body dentist.ics
< header ETag {etag:dentist.ics}

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 204
< header ETag {etag:dentist.ics}

# The default calendar is real now: own ctag, the entry listed.
> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><A:getetag/><B:getctag/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< responses 2
< body-lacks <cs:getctag>0-0</cs:getctag>
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics d:getetag {etag:dentist.ics}

# A PUT on the collection itself, the home set, or into a calendar that
# does not exist.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 405
< header-has Allow MKCALENDAR

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/missing/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 409

# Not calendar data by its type: 403 supported-calendar-data.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/other.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/plain
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 403
< error cal:supported-calendar-data

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/other.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=iso-8859-1
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 403
< error cal:supported-calendar-data

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/other.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar
>
> BEGIN:VCALENDAR
> this is no calendar
< status 403
< error cal:valid-calendar-data

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/other.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 404
